method.name: method2_cocell_secondary
method.description: secondary peaks sharing a range-Doppler cell
method.rationale: multiObjBeamForming (threshold 0.5) explicitly emits secondary angular peaks per range-Doppler cell. Turning it off in the .cfg and re-capturing is the controlled test.

rt_provenance: dense range profile (TLV 2), TI Q-format -> dB. Not a Doppler marginal: it is the measured range spectrum.
vt_provenance: SPARSE: detected points binned by Doppler. This is NOT the paper's dense VT -- CFAR removed sub-threshold micro-Doppler before the host saw it.
envelope_provenance: Eq.(2) applied to the per-frame detected-point speed set (percentile_98, median+3.0*MAD, smooth 3). SPARSE: post-CFAR points, not a dense VT column.
steps_provenance: peaks with v_min=0.20 m/s, min spacing 0.25 s, adaptive prominence 0.1706 (15% of envelope IQR), constrained to 4 walking segment(s) | Eq.(2) applied to the per-frame detected-point speed set (percentile_98, median+3.0*MAD, smooth 3). SPARSE: post-CFAR points, not a dense VT column.
